==About==

Crafting a {{i|Goldtilla}} will make an {{i|Unbaked Goldtilla}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a Goldtilla. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead.
